purpose: Policy-independent Dex3-to-rigid-proxy contact validation before any ACT-A/B physics evaluation.

fixed_material.name: MEDIUM_PREDECLARED_NOT_TUNED
fixed_material.rationale: One previously declared middle material is held fixed through collider/contact validation; friction is not a diagnostic variable.

shape_candidates.name: ellipsoid_prolate_v1
shape_candidates.rationale: One axisymmetric convex proxy derived before physics trials from the bilateral frozen-GRASP collision envelope; its vertical support radius preserves the historical tabletop center height.

shape_candidates.name: capsule_v1
shape_candidates.rationale: One simple convex capsule with the same cross-section and tabletop support envelope as the ellipsoid candidate.

shape_candidates.name: ellipsoid_contact_fit_v2
shape_candidates.rationale: Final bounded collision-envelope review: retain the v1 major axis and tabletop support height while adding exactly 0.5 mm transverse radius; declared before either hand is run.

shape_candidates.name: capsule_contact_fit_v2
shape_candidates.rationale: Final bounded collision-envelope review: add exactly 0.5 mm capsule radius and shorten the cylinder to preserve the v1 tabletop support height; declared before either hand is run.

stage_reset_semantics.FIXED_ARM_THREE_FINGER_CLOSE: Reset OPEN with proxy at the declared pose, keep gravity disabled, and execute only the frozen OPEN-to-GRASP hand closure with arms fixed.
stage_reset_semantics.STATIC_HOLD: Reset directly to the frozen closed GRASP joint state with no attachment, enable gravity, and hold for one second.
stage_reset_semantics.VERTICAL_LIFT_5CM: Reset directly to the same frozen closed GRASP joint state with no attachment, hold under gravity for 0.5 s, execute a 5 cm vertical arm lift, then hold 0.75 s.
